subject: Post-call: AcmeCorp security & subprocessor follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@acmecorp.com>, Priya Patel <priya.patel@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: AcmeCorp security & subprocessor follow-up

Hi Sam / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and agreed next steps from our discovery: 

- SOC 2: you asked whether Redwood is SOC 2 Type II — short answer: yes, we completed our most recent Type II audit in Q4 2025. I’ve linked the SOC 2 summary in the footer / related links and can share the full report under NDA.
- Data scope & residency: you confirmed production data will be processed in us-west-2 and that AcmeCorp needs confirmation no unapproved third-party processors access PII.
- Compliance needs: GDPR data subject requests and HIPAA (BAA) were raised as potential requirements depending on workloads. We support both; we will route you to Security to confirm controls and BAA process.
- Subprocessors: you requested a current subprocessor list (cloud providers, analytics, monitoring, etc.) and a simple mapping of what data each subprocesses.

Agreed next steps:
1) I will send our redwood_subprocessors CSV and a vendor security questionnaire for you to review (attached).
2) Sam / Priya to indicate which data classes you consider "sensitive / regulated" for this pilot (PII, health data, financial identifiers).
3) Our security lead (Aditya) will schedule a follow-up call if you want deeper control mapping or custom contractual language (e.g., data segregation, encryption at rest keys).

Deliverables I’ll attach in a follow-up: subprocessor list + vendor questionnaire. Expect those by end of week.

Thanks — talk soon.

--
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
(415) 555-0128

Hi Sam / Priya —

Attached are the items we discussed:
- redwood_subprocessors_2026-03-25.csv (short mapping of vendors + data classes)
- redwood_vendor_security_questionnaire.pdf (our completed questionnaire for quick reference)

High-level answers to your questions:
- SOC 2: our full report is available under NDA. I’ve shared the SOC 2 summary in related links. If procurement wants the full report, we can send it through our secure share after an NDA is signed.
- Production logs & third-party analytics: we use internal telemetry and a managed monitoring provider (Datamonitor Inc.) for runtime metrics only. Datamonitor does NOT receive request/response payloads or customer PII. Access to logs containing payloads is restricted to our security/ops teams and only exposed to subprocessors under strict contractual and technical controls (e.g., encryption, limited retention). See the subprocessor CSV for specific roles.
- BAA / HIPAA: we support BAA; Aditya will reach out to coordinate standard language and next steps if Acme confirms HIPAA applicability.

Next actions:
1) Priya / Sam — please confirm receipt and let us know which items (if any) require a follow-up deep-dive call.
2) If procurement wants the SOC 2 report, please confirm an NDA contact and we’ll route the full report via secure share.

Thanks —
